Notice to End your Tenancy at the End of the Term
N8
To: (Tenant's name): Joseph Mensah
From: (Landlord's name): Bayview Court Apartments (fictional)
Address of the Rental Unit: Apt 7, 900 Bayview Avenue, Toronto, Ontario
This is a legal notice that could lead to you being evicted from your home.
I am giving you this notice because I want to end your tenancy. I want you to move out of your rental unit by the following termination date: 31/12/2026.
Reason 1: You have persistently paid your rent late.
Details: Rent due on the 1st of the month was paid on 09/03/2026, 12/04/2026, 15/05/2026, 11/06/2026, 14/07/2026 and 10/08/2026.
